entries.text: Hi, it's Mia from Replogle Globes. Thanks for talking with me: your code, $20 off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. What brings you to Replogle Globes today?
Oh, I was just shopping for, like, a a brand new globe. Essentially, and I saw your website was... Looks pretty cool.
Glad the site caught your eye. What do you picture doing with the globe once it's in your home?
Have it, like, decorating the rest of my house and stuff. You know?
Decorating the house, got it. Which room are you thinking of putting it in?
